biotools.summary: wrnet is an R package implementing regularized win ratio regression for variable selection and risk prediction, particularly useful for hierarchical composite endpoints and cardiovascular trial analysis. The package provides a user-friendly interface and demonstrates improved accuracy compared to Cox regression models.
